item.title: About
item.description: Hello! My name is Giang (pronounced as yang). I was born and lived in Saigon, a city in southern Vietnam, for most of my life. I did my undergraduate studies in the US and graduated with a bachelor's in Biology and Mathematics after 3 years. I'm currently working as a Research Data Technician in the Henderson Lab at Van Andel Institute. My work focuses on computational analysis and modeling of neurodegenerative disease pathology and progression.
